title: F9 RECORDS YOUR PLAY FOR THE TITLE
why: His ask of 2026-10-08, the other half of attract mode: a way to record himself playing so the title can show it. F9 now starts recording the game (the world and the HUD, up to 1920 wide at 30 frames a second, with a red REC mark on screen that is not in the clip) and F9 again stops it; it stops by itself after 3 minutes. The clip becomes the one the title plays when nobody is playing, and a copy is saved to the downloads as pillagers-attract.webm.
now: Press F9 to record your play and F9 again to stop; the title then shows it when nobody is playing.
